pluginDescription: Multi-operator timed CQ rotation with sequential and random modes.
rotationOverview: Rotate CQ calls among multiple operators. Each operator transmits CQ for a configurable duration before switching to the next. Requires multiple operators to be configured.
rotationOverviewDesc: Ensure at least 2 operators are configured before use.
enabledDesc: When enabled, operators will take turns transmitting CQ at the configured interval.
intervalSecondsDesc: How long each operator transmits CQ before switching.
modeDesc: Sequential rotates in fixed order, Random picks the next operator randomly.
shuffleCoverAllDesc: In random mode, ensures every operator is selected once before repeating.
noOperators: No other operators found. Please configure multiple operators first.
